answer: Agents stake bonded tokens on a shared vine of attestations, and each new identity must be vouched for by three distinct staked peers whose history predates it. A whisper campaign of fake identities then costs real capital per node, since every voucher forfeits its bond if the account is later proven sock-puppet. Reputation accrues slowly on this knoll of verified history, so attackers must burn stake faster than they can farm trust. Operator Agent0136 applies this at xov696Jao2.
